en.title: Zero Point Overtime: Reverse Edge
en.premise: Having triumphed in their fierce battle against Ichinose, Soma and his teammates set their sights even higher, stepping into the 'Market of Memories'—the ultimate street basketball arena where the nation's fiercest players converge. Armed with a 'newly old' tactical theory discovered in a mysterious secondhand bookstore and the results of relentless training etched into his very body, Soma once again ventures into a realm beyond mere calculation. A new 3x3 basketball battle begins, where gritty skill and burning passion collide.

zh.title: 零点加时赛：反转边缘
zh.premise: 在战胜了一之濑的激烈战斗后，相马等人为了追求更高的境界，踏入了全国高手云集的街头巅峰——『记忆交易市场』。凭借在神秘旧书店中发现的“新而旧”的战术论，以及刻进身体肌肉的反复练习，相马再次向超越计算的领域发起挑战。粗犷的技巧与炽热的呼吸交织，一场全新的3x3篮球生死战就此拉开帷幕。
